limits: Builds finish before timed observations. Campaigns run sequentially on a shared host; unrelated services remain running.
Console and wire fixtures differ and cannot establish a direct transport-overhead comparison.
Read and narrow mutation p95 require twenty samples per case. Wide, nested and wire mutations have three; no p99 is claimed.
Instrumented attempts include overlapping background work and proxy overhead; they are not fsync counts or additive durations.
Resident samples use per-role maximum child VmHWM, not summed RSS or a provider-wide cardinality bound.
The baseline wire build uses only the retained build-graph patch; no baseline runtime implementation is changed.
The baseline retained-history campaign failed; its completed mutations do not make the concurrent-reader workload pass.
Empty and LIMIT 0 console reads remain slower in the final repeated control; no universal improvement or production SLO is claimed.
Clean committed-source CI is a separate qualification, reported with its exact revision in the PR.

Consumer command seconds include shell/build time where present and are not matched latency measurements. Two Flight fault attempts failed in Nix before execution; the direct cache-disabled retry is separately recorded.
